_comment: Nodes of the Research & Skills Graph. group: domain | method | tool | project. Links are site-relative ('/projects/<id>/', '#pub-<key>', '#talks') or absolute URLs. No skill levels by design.

nodes.label: Phonon thermal transport
nodes.description: Lattice thermal conductivity and phonon-mediated heat flow in semiconductors and heterostructures. The common thread of my Ph.D. research.

nodes.label: Phonon properties
nodes.description: Phonon dispersion, density of states, lifetimes and localized vibrational modes, including region-resolved spectra at defects.

nodes.label: Interfacial thermal transport
nodes.description: Heat transfer across material interfaces and defects, such as dislocations at GaN/sapphire interfaces and band-paired interface transmission in BTE solvers.

nodes.label: Multiscale modeling
nodes.description: Connecting first-principles and atomistic results to the phonon BTE and to device-scale Fourier models.

nodes.label: Thermal management of GaN electronics
nodes.description: Channel temperature and thermal resistance of GaN power and RF transistors.

nodes.label: Scientific machine learning
nodes.description: Machine learning built on physics: learned interatomic potentials and physics-informed neural networks for transport equations.

nodes.label: High-performance computing
nodes.description: GPU-accelerated solvers and large simulation campaigns on research clusters.

nodes.label: Solar energy and radiative cooling
nodes.description: Earlier work at Xi'an Jiaotong University: spectral splitting for CPV/T–hydrogen systems, radiative cooling films and solar water harvesting.

nodes.label: Density functional theory
nodes.description: First-principles energies and forces used as training data for machine-learned potentials and as reference phonon calculations.

nodes.label: Molecular dynamics
nodes.description: Equilibrium MD for vibrational spectra (velocity autocorrelation) of large interface models.

nodes.label: Machine-learned interatomic potentials
nodes.description: Self-trained Deep Potential models and foundation potentials (MACE, DPA) that bring near-DFT accuracy to large systems.

nodes.label: Anharmonic lattice dynamics
nodes.description: Harmonic and third-order force constants, three-phonon scattering and lattice thermal conductivity.

nodes.label: Phonon Boltzmann transport equation
nodes.description: Deterministic, multi-band solutions of the phonon BTE for non-diffusive heat transport, including band discretization.

nodes.label: Coupled BTE–Fourier modeling
nodes.description: Solving the BTE near nanoscale hot spots and Fourier conduction in the rest of the device.

nodes.label: Atomistic Green's function
nodes.description: Elastic phonon transmission and interfacial thermal conductance from harmonic force constants.

nodes.label: Physics-informed neural networks
nodes.description: Neural-network solvers for the phonon BTE with hard-encoded, angle-dependent boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Optical and thermal experiments
nodes.description: Nanomaterial and composite preparation; spectrophotometry, FT-IR, SEM, XRD, GC; outdoor cooling and system tests.

nodes.label: VASP
nodes.description: DFT code used for first-principles reference data.

nodes.label: LAMMPS
nodes.description: Molecular dynamics engine, used in the GaN/Al₂O₃ interface work.

nodes.label: ASE
nodes.description: Atomic Simulation Environment for building structures and driving calculators.

nodes.label: DeePMD-kit
nodes.description: Training and running Deep Potential models.

nodes.label: DP-GEN
nodes.description: Concurrent (active) learning to grow Deep Potential training sets.

nodes.label: MACE
nodes.description: Equivariant foundation interatomic potential.

nodes.label: DPA
nodes.description: Pretrained Deep Potential foundation model.

nodes.label: phono3py
nodes.description: Anharmonic phonon calculations and lattice thermal conductivity.

nodes.label: ALAMODE
nodes.description: Force constants and phonon properties; also supplies mode tables for BTE solvers.

nodes.label: JAX-BTE
nodes.description: GPU deterministic phonon BTE solver written in JAX; I contributed band discretization schemes.

nodes.label: Python
nodes.description: Main language for simulation workflows and analysis (NumPy, SciPy).

nodes.label: JAX
nodes.description: Array programming and GPU acceleration for BTE solvers.

nodes.label: GPU computing
nodes.description: Multi-GPU workstation and cluster runs of BTE and MLIP workloads.

nodes.label: UGE / HTCondor clusters
nodes.description: Batch computing at the Notre Dame Center for Research Computing.

nodes.label: COMSOL Multiphysics
nodes.description: Finite-element heat transfer and optics simulation in the earlier solar energy projects.

nodes.label: AI coding agents
nodes.description: Agentic development with Claude Code and Codex, plus a multi-agent research workflow with Git-versioned shared project memory.

nodes.label: GaN/Al₂O₃ dislocation phonons
nodes.description: Phonon spectra and interfacial thermal transport at dislocation cores. Manuscript in preparation.

nodes.label: MLIPs for InGaAs
nodes.description: Concurrent-learning Deep Potential and foundation potentials for thermal transport in InGaAs alloys. Presented at ICT 2026.

nodes.label: GaN transistor thermal modeling
nodes.description: Multiscale BTE–Fourier thermal modeling of GaN transistors, sponsored by Lockheed Martin. Presented at SHTC 2025 and SciML@ND 2026.

nodes.label: BTE band discretization
nodes.description: Frequency–mean-free-path band binning for deterministic phonon BTE solvers. Manuscript in preparation.

nodes.label: PINN for phonon BTE (paper)
nodes.description: Co-authored paper: physics-informed neural networks with hard-encoded angle-dependent boundary conditions for the phonon BTE, Materials Today Physics (2025).

nodes.label: Solar energy projects (XJTU)
nodes.description: Radiative cooling films, CPV/T–hydrogen spectral splitting and solar water harvesting; 11 journal papers.
